items.text_th: ตั้งแต่ย้ายมา เจอปัญหาเรื่องระบบไป2รอบละ ใส่โค้ดผ่านลิงก์ไม่ได้ บัญชีถูกรีเซ็ต ก็ยังดีที่เอากลับคืนมาได้ ไหนจะคนวาร์ป โปรปาร์ตี้ น่าหงุดหงิดสุดๆ จ่ายแพงขึ้นแต่แลกมาด้วยระบบที่ไม่เสถียร โดยรวมคือ แย่ค่ะ
items.text_vn: Từ khi chuyển sang đây, mình đã gặp lỗi hệ thống 2 lần rồi: không nhập code qua link được, tài khoản bị reset — may là lấy lại được. Chưa kể người dùng hack dịch chuyển, hack phá party, bực mình hết sức. Trả tiền đắt hơn mà đổi lại là hệ thống không ổn định. Nói chung là tệ.
items.summary_vn: Sau khi chuyển VNG gặp lỗi code, reset tài khoản, nhiều hack, giá đắt.
items.text_en:
Since moving here I've hit system bugs twice:
- Can't enter codes via the link
- My account got reset (luckily I got it back)
Not to mention teleport hackers and party-wrecking hackers, so frustrating. Paying more and getting an unstable system in return. Overall, bad.
items.summary_en: After the move to VNG: code bugs, account reset, many hackers, higher prices.

items.text_th: เอาเปิดลิงค์ ใน YouTube คืนมา!!!!!!!!!!! ลงทุนไปตั้งเยอะกับบ้านอันแสนสุข แต่กลับมาพังความสนุกโลกในเกมและโลกส่วนตัวของเรา ไม่ยอม!!! เอากลับคืนมาเดี๋ยวนี้!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
items.text_vn: Trả lại tính năng mở link YouTube đi!!!!!!!!!!! Mình đã đầu tư bao nhiêu vào ngôi nhà hạnh phúc, vậy mà giờ lại phá hỏng niềm vui thế giới trong game và thế giới riêng của mình. Không chấp nhận!!! Trả lại ngay lập tức!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.summary_vn: Đòi trả lại tính năng mở link YouTube trong nhà.
items.text_en: Bring back the YouTube link feature!!!!!!!!!!! I invested so much in my happy home, and now you've ruined the fun of the game world and my own little world. Not acceptable!!! Bring it back right now!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
items.summary_en: Demands the in-house YouTube link feature be brought back.
